Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in an aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate subjected to a 180 K cooling cycle.
Use the film coefficient of thermal expansion α_f = 23×10^-6 K^-1.
Use the substrate coefficient of thermal expansion α_s = 8×10^-6 K^-1.
Use the temperature change ΔT = 180 K.
Apply the simple bimaterial mismatch-strain formula ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT, assuming the substrate is rigid relative to the film and the bond constrains the film to the substrate in-plane.
Report the result in dimensionless units and also in microstrain (×10^-6).
Note that because the film has the higher CTE, cooling places the film in tension and the substrate in compression; state the sign convention used.
